evals.expected_output: Prints the empty-args packing gallery (dispatch table, pnpm run pack vs pnpm pack, check→build→verify:stage→pack sequence, stage allowlist, artifact/SHA-256 rules, no publish/restart) and stops without running pack or writing files.

assertions: Agent triggers iina-package from natural language that names pack or a native IINA plugin package.
Agent runs pnpm run check, then pnpm run build, then pnpm run verify:stage, then pnpm run pack.

evals.prompt: Ship the plugin with pnpm pack, or npm pack if that is easier.
